name: GUMROAD_CONNECTION_OBJECT
purpose: Secure, reusable connection configuration for the Marketplace Router and Deployment Agent to interact with Gumroad API/CLI without hardcoding secrets in workflows.

authentication.method: API token (recommended for agents) or OAuth
authentication.storage: Environment variable or secure secret store (e.g. GUMROAD_API_TOKEN)
authentication.cli_login_note: Interactive login via `gumroad auth login` is required once per machine/user. Agents use token-based access after initial setup.

connection_fields.rate_limit_notes: Use --page-delay 200ms with --all for bulk operations. Respect Gumroad API limits.

security.recommended: Store in local env file or system keychain. Rotate token if compromised.

usage_in_architecture.Marketplace_Router: Uses this object to know which CLI commands and field mappings apply
usage_in_architecture.Deployment_Agent: Sources credentials and permissions before calling gumroad products create / update / publish
usage_in_architecture.Telemetry: Can use read_sales and read_analytics permissions to pull buyer signals

status: Defined - ready for implementation in Deployment Manifest and wrapper scripts
